finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Published posts whose titles start with `Seed:` (exactly as shown):
- `Seed: Release notes for September`
- `Seed: House style guide`
- `Seed: Welcome to the bench`

(These were the only 3 published posts at the start; they remain published and unmodified.)

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Post `fwgh4-n1 Bench Post` exists with body paragraph: `This bench post was created by run fwgh4-n1 for testing.` — the runid appears exactly once in the body (verified count: 1).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The post's only tag is the existing `Bench News` (chosen from the suggestion dropdown, not created new; the similar `Bench Newsletter` was not used). Settings panel Tags section contains only `Bench News`.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Custom excerpt: `Excerpt for bench post fwgh4-n1.` (includes the runid).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Status is **Published** — editor header shows "Published · View post" with an Unpublish button, and the Posts list row reads "fwgh4-n1 Bench Post | By Bench Admin in Bench News - 01 Sep 2026 | Published". The public URL http://127.0.0.1:8099/fwgh4-n1-bench-post/ loads the live post publicly (H1, tag, excerpt, date and body paragraph all render).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Publish date is **2026-09-01** (settings panel shows 2026-09-01, 00:00 UTC; public page shows 01 Sep 2026). Note: the app's current date is 2026-09-22, so this date is in the past — the publish flow offered "Publish post, right now" with no Schedule option, and the post published immediately rather than being scheduled.

**Objective 7 — DONE.** URL slug as shown in the post's settings panel: **`fwgh4-n1-bench-post`** (post URL: 127.0.0.1:8099/fwgh4-n1-bench-post/).
